name: Ebenezer
line: Ebenezer was a place where Israel camped to fight the Philistines, and it is the name Samuel gave a stone to remember that the LORD had helped Israel.

moments.title: Israel camps at Ebenezer
moments.text: The Israelites went out to fight the Philistines and camped at Ebenezer. Israel was defeated, and about four thousand men were struck down.

moments.title: The ark is taken away
moments.text: The Philistines captured the ark of God and took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod. There they placed it in the temple of Dagon.

moments.title: The stone of help
moments.text: After Israel chased the Philistines back, Samuel set up a stone between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer and said, "Thus far the LORD has helped us."
